scope: Coinbase CDP x402 Bazaar index at one point in time, not all agent transactions
attribution: Fetchgate audit and probes (CC BY 4.0 for publisher probe fields); Coinbase public index counters attributed to Coinbase
caveats: Coinbase index counters and unique payer addresses are not independently verified customer identities, real buyer intent or AgentMine revenue.
Single unauthenticated GET probe cannot determine POST-only service availability: 405 is not proof of downtime.
Price comparison mismatches show catalog price cannot substitute for a live x402 handshake.
Publisher's calls times minimum listed price is a pricing proxy, not independently audited settled USD, and not a rigorous upper bound if variable actual prices exceed listed minima.
Farm classification based on more than 300 listings per registrable domain can group unrelated sellers on shared hosting domains.
Do not infer customer willingness to pay, paid delivery, full-market revenue or platform profitability from this snapshot.
agentmine_decision: Prioritize read-only price reconciliation and actual paid-delivery verification over generic discovery counts; require observed live quote before real payment routing. No payment or deployment authorized.
